items.name: Mitsubishi mini-split system (3 indoor heads)
items.notes: Optional anti-allergy inserts MAC-408FT-E (2-pack per head, 3 packs total). Washable main screens U01A01100.

schedules.title: Vacuum mini-split allergy inserts
schedules.checklist:
- Vacuum the MAC-408FT-E inserts in all 3 heads
- If vacuuming isn't enough, rinse, press in a towel and dry fully in the shade
- While the covers are open, check the washable main screens

schedules.title: Replace mini-split allergy inserts
schedules.checklist:
- Order 3 packs of MAC-408FT-E (one per head)
- Swap the inserts in all 3 heads

schedules.title: Clean dehumidifier water tank
schedules.checklist: - Empty the tank, wash it with mild soap and let it dry before refitting
